scripts.gen: bun run schema:db && bun run schema:pull && prisma generate --sql
scripts.check: bun run gen && git diff --exit-code prisma/schema.prisma && tsc --noEmit && biome ci . && bun test
scripts.build:arm64: bun run gen && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/main.ts --outfile build/darwin-arm64/board
scripts.build:x64: bun run gen && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 src/main.ts --outfile build/darwin-x64/board
